findings.claim: Regional whole-window coordinate contrast evidence is supplied for the observed selection nodes over the complete observed window [0.0, 0.49]; these are signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed nodes, not absolute geometric descriptors.

Endpoint-mining whole-window effects and the sparse coordinate prior are available as coordinate-level observations; they are untyped coordinate proxies and are not physical interaction energies or evidence of neural-module causation.
Whole-window velocity effects are supplied as a temporal-derivative quantity; a temporal derivative is not a coordinate gradient and cannot be substituted for the endpoint-coordinate reward.

Terminal-lineage survival effects are recorded, but selection, survival, last-record joint-head labels and decoded terminal rescoring have different semantics; survival enrichment is not an absolute geometric descriptor.
Joint-contrast and branch-mutation whole-window effects are supplied as separate contrast families; repeated descendants are not additional independent statistical units.
The supplied static and endpoint-reference configurations bind the FLOWR model, reference and integrator; the teacher-mode temperature is fixed and no temperature edit is present or permitted.

The information audit and study evidence record the observed support and label semantics: recorded affinities are removed with an equal score prior, and decoded terminal learning labels are not available.
The declared objective remains final predicted target affinity primary, with validity and strain secondary; coordinate control is the only control channel represented in this evidence.

limitations: Only regional contrast evidence is supplied in this isolated interface probe.
Transformed copies are never production evidence or inputs to compilation.
Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable; missing future quality is unobserved.
No current study outcome data are supplied to the design roles.
Selection contrasts are not supplied as a prerequisite in this probe.
